videos.title: Access the Power of Now to Experience Life More Fully | Eckhart Tolle
videos.description:
Eckhart Tolle is a world-revered spiritual teacher and author known for sharing practical tools that allow people to experience life more richly. We discuss, and Eckhart demonstrates, how you can access greater inner peace, authenticity, creativity, and connection in your everyday life. Eckhart also shares tools for quieting compulsive thinking, accessing inner stillness, and adopting a helpful mental vantage point when life gets challenging. We also discuss how to balance your pursuit of external goals with your spiritual growth and relationships and, in doing so, foster a deeper sense of well-being.

videos.title: I Asked GitHub's COO if CS Grads Are Cooked

We get into whether AI means fewer developer jobs, what CS students should actually be doing right now, whether LeetCode still matters, and if vibe coding is a shortcut or a trap. videos.title: #1 CELEBRITY MEDIUM: How Your Loved Ones Talk to You After They Die
videos.description:
Laura Lynne Jackson talks to people on the other side for a living. What she learned there changed how she sees death and grief.

In this episode, Laura Lynne Jackson and Jay Shetty talk about what a medium knows about death, and why she believes the people we love still reach us. Laura explains the difference between a psychic and a medium, the day at age 11 when she knew she had to go see her grandfather, and what scientists found when they put EEG scanners on her brain.

She shares the signs she says our loved ones send, from flickering lights to coins in our path, why she asks for aardvarks instead of butterflies, and a near-death study about a red shoe on the roof of a hospital.

Learn why a relationship with someone who died can grow stronger. And learn what a sign means when you are not sure it is real.
